def find_k(n, first_half_incomes, last_month_income):
    # Check if the last half of the months has a profit
    if all(income > 0 for income in last_half_incomes):
        return n
    
    # Try different values of k
    for k in range(1, n // 2 + 1):
        # Calculate the sum of profits for each k consecutive months
        profits = [sum(first_half_incomes[i:i+k]) for i in range(len(first_half_incomes) - k + 1)]
        
        # Check if all profits are positive
        if all(profit > 0 for profit in profits):
            return k
    
    # If no such k exists, return -1
    return -1
